panels.title: Service level objectives (over the selected time range)
Bets succeed
panels.description: Share of bets the server answered without internal_error or unavailable; rejections (no balance, betting closed) are answers, not failures. Objective: at least 99.9%.

panels.title: Cash-outs succeed
panels.description: Share of cash-outs answered without internal_error or unavailable. Objective: at least 99.9%.

panels.title: Bets within 200 ms
panels.description: Share of bets answered within 200 ms on the server, counted from the 0.2 s bucket, not interpolated. Objective: at least 99.9%.

panels.title: Cash-outs within 200 ms
panels.description: Share of cash-outs answered within 200 ms on the server. Objective: at least 99.9%.

panels.title: Ticks within 50 ms
panels.description: Share of ticks fired at most 50 ms later than planned. Objective: at least 99%.

panels.title: Money mismatches
panels.description: Most broken money invariants any reconciliation found in the range, all types together. Objective: 0.

panels.title: Since last reconciliation
panels.description: Time since the last completed reconciliation, now. It runs every minute; objective: at most 5 minutes.

panels.title: Stuck bets
panels.description: Most ACTIVE bets of earlier rounds that a settlement sweep could not settle, in the range. Objective: 0.

panels.title: Tick delay
panels.description: How much later than planned each round tick fired (ADR-0006). Empty between rounds: ticks only fire while a round runs.

panels.title: Ticks per second
panels.description: About 10 while a round runs (one tick per 100 ms), averaged over the rate window (at least 20 s), which also covers betting and the pause.

panels.title: Player latency
panels.description: What players wait for a bet or cash-out answer, from the moment the bot planned the request (ADR-0008), p50 and p99 by type.

panels.title: Player requests by result
panels.description: Answers per second as bots see them, by type and result.

panels.title: Bots
panels.description: Bots the run aims for and bots connected now.

panels.title: Tick jitter (players)
panels.description: How much later than 100 ms after the previous tick bots received a tick, p99.

panels.title: Connection problems
panels.description: Failed logins and socket connections, and sockets closed by the server, per window.

panels.title: Generator health
panels.description: The generator's own event loop lag p99 and CPU. When they climb, the generator is the bottleneck and player latency is not trustworthy.

panels.title: Requests per second
panels.description: Bet and cash-out messages answered per second (RED: rate), over 10 s, so a burst is not flattened by a long window. Prometheus scrapes every 5 s, so one request alone shows as 0.1.

panels.title: Outcomes per second
panels.description: success: accepted or replayed; rejected: a business answer such as betting_closed or insufficient_funds (like HTTP 4xx); failed: internal_error or unavailable, the server could not do it (like HTTP 5xx).

panels.title: Failed share
panels.description: Share of requests the server failed (internal_error, unavailable). Should stay at 0.

panels.title: Requests by result
panels.description: Requests per window by type and result, as counts: one request shows as 1.

panels.title: Request duration
panels.description: From receipt of a bet or cashout message to the response, by type. Does not include time waiting behind a busy event loop.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Open sockets tracked by the gateway, including those waiting for the token check.

panels.title: Broadcast duration p99
panels.description: Synchronous time to serialize one broadcast and hand it to every socket, by message type. Grows with the number of clients.

panels.title: Buffered bytes
panels.description: Data queued for slow clients at scrape time: total over all sockets and the largest single socket.

panels.title: Money operations in flight
panels.description: Bets, cashouts, auto-cashouts and settlements started and not finished. Rises when the database is the bottleneck.

panels.title: Database pool
panels.description: The app pool at scrape time. Waiting > 0 means requests queue for a connection (they give up after 1 s).

panels.title: Unsettled bets
panels.description: ACTIVE bets of earlier rounds the last settlement sweep could not settle (max over instances). Above 0 means bets are stuck until a sweep settles them.

panels.title: Auto-cashouts
panels.description: Bets due for auto-cashout per window, by trigger and result.

panels.title: Settled bets
panels.description: Bets handled by settlement sweeps per window, by result.

panels.title: Reconciliation mismatches
panels.description: Broken money invariants found by the last reconciliation, by type (ADR-0007). Anything above 0 needs investigation.

panels.title: Since last reconciliation
panels.description: Seconds since the last completed reconciliation. Growing past the interval (60 s by default) means it stopped working.

panels.title: Round write failures
panels.description: Failed round writes per window, by operation. mark_crashed counts every failed attempt of the retried crash write.

panels.title: Failed settlement sweeps
panels.description: Sweeps that could not read the unsettled bets, per window.

panels.title: Draining
panels.description: 1 while an instance shuts down and drains requests.

panels.title: Event loop lag
panels.description: From monitorEventLoopDelay, reset on every scrape (each point covers 5 s). An idle process reads about 10 ms (the measuring interval): the real lag is the value minus about 10 ms.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Share of one core used by the process.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Resident set size and V8 heap.

panels.title: GC time
panels.description: Share of time spent in garbage collection, by kind.
